card.name: Laminar flow hood in preparation text
card.fires_on: The word ending "ar" in "laminar" (and the following "flow") in sentences about preparing drugs in a laminar flow hood or clean work area. Also "or" in "hood (or an equivalent clean air...".

card.writes: It pushes toward room-type words such as room and rooms, suggesting a clean-room or hood setting comes next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text says laminar flow hood, the clean workspace used to prepare sterile drugs.
